summary: Phase 1 Hybrid Marketplace Booking - full backend + frontend E2E validated. Backend: 11/11 pytest passing in /app/backend/tests/test_marketplace.py covering marketplace search modes (marketplace vs auction), per-aircraft ferry/repositioning math (mkt-ac-001 Mumbai ferry=0; mkt-ac-002 Bell/Pune ~Rs.6,350; mkt-ac-003 Agusta/Delhi ~Rs.56,865), invalid aircraft_type -> 400, cargo passengers=5 forces auction mode, instant book creates MKT-prefixed booking with 15-min price lock and Stripe checkout with 50% advance, full auction e2e (start -> operator quote via /api/auctions/{id}/quote -> customer live poll with operator_name enrichment != 'Unknown' -> accept creates payable MKT booking -> quote_selected state), and 403 security when a second customer probes /live or /accept. Frontend: /marketplace/results renders feasibility banner (Route OK, distance, ETA, service, fixed-route badge, long-route warning), 4 helicopter options with images/operator/AirYatra Verified/rating/seats/pilot hrs/ETA/amenities/full breakdown (Base + Ferry + Fees + GST), AI Pick banner (Bell 407GXi highlighted with orange border and 'AI Pick: 4.7* rated operator, 5,100+ hrs pilot experience'), Book Now navigates to /customer/payment/{id} showing MKT booking # / Rs.96,177 (50% advance) / remaining amount / Stripe test-mode footer. Auction mode: Start 20-min Reverse Auction button reveals live-auction-panel with auction-countdown starting at 19:59 and 'Waiting for live quotes from operators... refresh every 5 seconds' placeholder, plus 'X operators notified' badge. Modify Search returns to /booking.

issues: auction-countdown updates only every ~5s (tied to server polling); the digit does not tick smoothly per second, which reads as 'stuck' momentarily. Consider a client-side 1s decrement between polls for smoother UX.

action_items: OPTIONAL UX: In MarketplaceResults.js CountdownTimer, drive seconds_left with a local 1000ms setInterval that decrements between the 5s server polls (reset to server value on each poll response) so the reverse-auction timer visibly ticks each second.
critical_code_review_comments: marketplace_routes._price_option computes ferry_charge = ferry_km * ferry_rate_per_km only when ferry_km > free_radius (25km). Correctly returns 0 for mkt-ac-001 Mumbai-based pickup at same coords. LGTM.

marketplace_routes.auction_live_state performs operator_name enrichment (fallback to db.operators.company_name -> users.full_name -> 'AirYatra Partner Operator'). Verified in E2E: quote returns 'AirYatra' rather than 'Unknown'. LGTM.

marketplace_routes.auction_accept_and_checkout marks losing quotes as rejected via update_many and flips auction to quote_selected atomically-ish (three sequential awaits, not transactional). For a marketplace of this scale acceptable, but consider a Mongo transaction if double-accept race becomes a concern.

auction quote total_amount = base_price * 1.18 (GST) inside the auction quote endpoint (200000 -> 236000). This is applied at quote submission, so the customer-visible auction quote total already includes GST. The instant-book path in _price_option adds convenience_fee + GST separately. Both paths reach a consistent taxed total but the composition differs; document this so operators quoting a 'base_price' understand GST is added downstream.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on marketplace results, book flow, auction UI, and modify-search regression

seed_data_creation: Test-generated: 1 marketplace MKT booking (mkt-ac-001) + 1 UI-driven MKT booking + 1 backend auction (Jaipur -> Kargil, quote_selected) + 1 UI-driven auction (Jaipur -> Kargil-UI-Test, active). Pre-existing seed_marketplace_fleet.py fleet used (13 aircraft mkt-ac-001..013).
